high_level_description: This image is a collage of three photographs taken at the @ntu_sg Satellite Research Centre (SaRC) in Singapore, where the nation's latest satellite, ELITE, was showcased. Top Photograph: Setting: The top photograph shows an interior view of the SaRC facility. The room is modern and technologically advanced, with multiple computer monitors on desks, large screens displaying satellite imagery, and a high-tech ceiling with exposed ductwork.
